cards.distinctiveCost: Both outer interceptors abandon ordinary Well pressure before a carrier is confirmed.
cards.mission: Pre-position two Towlines and force one exact returning Core loose.

cards.distinctiveCost: The carrier pauses while a Lantern and screen leave their baseline jobs.
cards.mission: Probe a risky fork, choose one route once, and bring the carrier home.

cards.distinctiveCost: The Towlines react late and must choose north or south from causal sight.
cards.mission: React to a revealed return route and force the exact carrier off that lane.

cards.distinctiveCost: Two bodies give up current-theater pressure for a timed future position.
cards.mission: Move two of three reserves across theaters before the next public Well beat.

cards.distinctiveCost: A carrier and guard surrender delivery tempo to answer visible pressure.
cards.mission: Hold a pressured carrier, then choose a direct or counter route home.

cards.distinctiveCost: The breach concentrates a Veil and one reserve into one exposed lane.
cards.mission: Stage a Veil-led pair and cross the contested centre under signature cover.

cards.distinctiveCost: A Mason and Lantern stop contesting objectives to protect one return.
cards.mission: Build a two-body gate that keeps a pressured carrier's home line open.

cards.distinctiveCost: The receiver holds a catch lane instead of fighting or collecting.
cards.mission: Set a receiver behind a Relay carrier and complete a bounded Core return.

cards.distinctiveCost: The decoy is isolated and the opposite pair concedes centre coverage.
cards.mission: Show one body north, then send a paired strike through the south lane.

cards.distinctiveCost: The Switchback leaves interception before the carrier is guaranteed to survive.
cards.mission: Bring a Switchback to a wounded carrier and complete the emergency return.
